entities.summary: The Basilica of St. Gerard Majella or the Basilica of Curvelo is a church of the Catholic Church, located in Curvelo, in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. It was built in 1906 by Dutch Redemptorist missionaries and is the only basilica in the world dedicated to this Redemptorist saint.
